conflicts_and_limits: CODEOWNERS is not access control; source conflates ownership review with authorization.
Generic repository-model choice does not authorize changing the approved function-owned polyrepo estate.
Provider/tool lists are examples, not exclusive capabilities or purchase requirements.
Cloud development, registry publication, Pages hosting, integrations and repository protections require applicable explicit approval.
Repository-model benefits are contextual predictions rather than local measured outcomes.
